nodes.name: farm auth + authorization
nodes.description: The de-facto shared auth dependency for the whole ops backend, not just farm_manager: mushroom_manager's 8 routers, genetics, protocols, purchasing, attachments and src/api/v1/tools/* all authenticate through it. Parallel implementation to core.middleware.auth (it does NOT import it) - HTTPBearer + jose jwt.decode against core_settings.SECRET_KEY with farm settings.ALGORITHM, reads the userId claim, loads the user from the users collection via farm_db, and 403s on isActive=false. CurrentUser is a plain class (not Pydantic) carrying userId/email/firstName/lastName/role/isActive/isEmailVerified/organizationId - note userId, not id. get_current_active_user re-checks isActive; despite the docstring it does NOT check isEmailVerified. require_farm_access(farm_id) short-circuits for super_admin/admin, otherwise requires an active farm_assignments row for (userId, farmId). require_permission(perm) is a dependency factory doing role-list checks over four hard-coded permission strings ('farm.manage' and 'agronomist' -> admin/super_admin/moderator; 'farm.operate' -> those plus user; 'admin' -> admin/super_admin) with a 'TODO: Implement proper permission system'. FAILS OPEN: any permission string not in that if/elif chain (e.g. a mushroom.* or typo'd string) falls through and authorises every authenticated user - genetics.middleware.auth was forked specifically to fail closed instead. Also depends on farm_manager.config.settings (ALGORITHM), which has no node in the graph yet. The package __init__.py re-exports only get_current_user/get_current_active_user/require_farm_access, so consumers import require_permission and CurrentUser from .auth directly.
nodes._layer_note: layer 'middleware' matches the sibling module-scoped middleware nodes sales.middleware.auth and genetics.middleware.auth; core.middleware.* uses layer 'core' because those nodes are module 'core'.

nodes.name: farm_manager middleware package
nodes.description: Re-export barrel for the farm_manager middleware package. Deliberately narrow __all__ - it omits CurrentUser, security and require_permission, which is why every consumer (mushroom_manager, genetics, protocols, purchasing, attachments, core tools routers) imports from src.modules.farm_manager.middleware.auth directly rather than from the package.
